# vastdata_callhome_config (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_callhome_config" "vastdb_callhome_config" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the Call Home configuration (typically 1).

### Optional

- `aggregated` (Boolean) If true, send aggregated callhome logs, otherwise upload logs from each node (deprecated)
- `alt_s3_host_port` (String) Alternative S3 service host for upload.
- `aws_s3_ak` (String) S3 Bucket access key
- `aws_s3_bucket_name` (String) S3 Bucket for upload
- `aws_s3_bucket_subdir` (String) Sub-Directory in support bucket
- `aws_s3_sk` (String) S3 Bucket secret key
- `bundle_enabled` (Boolean) Enabled/disabled periodic bundle callhome
- `bundle_interval` (Number) Interval in seconds for periodic bundle
- `callhome_upload_destination` (String) Callhome upload destination
- `cloud_api_domain` (String) The domain name for the Cloud API
- `cloud_api_key` (String) The API Key for the Cloud API
- `cloud_enabled` (Boolean) Is Cloud reporting modules enabled
- `cloud_registered` (Boolean) Is the cluster registered with VAST Cloud Services
- `cloud_subdomain` (String) The Customer's subdomain in Vast Cloud Services
- `compress_method` (String) Compression method for callhome bundles (by default zstd)
- `customer` (String) Customer/Company name
- `customer_id` (String) The id issued to the customer
- `location` (String) Site location
- `log_enabled` (Boolean) Enabled/disabled periodic log callhome
- `log_interval` (Number) Interval in seconds for periodic log
- `luna_analyze_period` (Number) Analyzed period size, minutes
- `luna_on_alarm_enabled` (Boolean) Enabled/disabled luna analyzing tool on specific alarms
- `luna_on_alarm_interval` (Number) Maximum allowed frequency in hours for alarm-triggered luna
- `max_upload_bandwidth` (Number) Maximum upload bandwidth in bytes
- `max_upload_concurrency` (Number) Maximum upload concurrency
- `obfuscated` (Boolean) If true, callhome data is obfuscated
- `proxy_host` (String) Proxy IP/hostname
- `proxy_password` (String) Proxy password
- `proxy_port` (String) Proxy Port
- `proxy_scheme` (String) http, https, socks5, socks5h
- `proxy_username` (String) Proxy username
- `site` (String) Site name
- `ssl_certificate` (String) SSL Certificate file content, including the BEGIN CERTIFICATE and END CERTIFICATE lines
- `support_channel` (Boolean) Enable/disable the VAST support channel
- `test_mode` (Boolean) enable/disable test mode
- `upload_via_vms` (Boolean) If true, upload non-aggregated Callhome Bundle via VMS. Otherwise, upload from each node.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) Enable/disable ssl certificate verification
